informal_restatement.author: Formalia 维护者（据 formal-conjectures 文档注释翻译）
informal_restatement.text: 每个有限群都同构于有理数域的某个伽罗瓦扩张的伽罗瓦群。
informal_restatement.text_en:
The **Inverse Galois Problem**: every finite group is
isomorphic to the Galois group of a Galois extension of the
rationals.
